text: Which gas do plants take in for photosynthesis? Choices: A. oxygen; B. carbon dioxide (variant 0)
explanation: Plants take in carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

text: What pulls a dropped ball toward the ground? Choices: A. gravity; B. magnetism (variant 1)
explanation: Gravity pulls objects toward Earth.

text: Which metal is attracted to a magnet? Choices: A. iron; B. copper (variant 2)
explanation: Iron is magnetic; copper is not.

text: What happens to water left in the sun? Choices: A. it evaporates; B. it freezes (variant 3)
explanation: Heat turns liquid water into vapour.

text: What travels faster, light or sound? Choices: A. light; B. sound (variant 4)
explanation: Light is far faster than sound.
